title: Why Are You Running?
blurb: Genuine bewilderment escalating into full pursuit, all within a couple of seconds. The line comes from a Nigerian film scene that went global around 2018 and immediately became the internet's default chase audio, largely because the question is so reasonable and so clearly not going to be answered. Lay it over any footage of something fleeing: pets who have stolen food, toddlers with an escape plan, a robot vacuum retreating from a spill, your own motivation on a Monday morning. A certified hall-of-famer with no signs of retirement.
origin: From a Nollywood film scene that went globally viral around 2018.
